items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember, because I always think about Jimmy Blanton and Charlie Christian dying around the same time.

ctx.x: Yeah. It’s just incredible. Their deaths were just months apart, Gaston and Blanton. Then who did he hire? Did he hire Mingus?
No, that was before Mingus. I can see him, but I can’t think. It was before Aaron Bell. I’ll think of it before we finish, because that was around ’41, ’42. I
remember, because I always think about Jimmy Blanton and Charlie Christian dying around the same time. Then now you mention Harold Gaston as well.
